# Joseph

## Overview

- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Family:** [Barbara Shaw](../character/barbara-shaw.md) (relative)

## Appearance

Joseph is a chubby child who turns red and stumbles over his words when frightened. He is also described as a spotted little creature.

_Sources: [v2 XII A Jonah Day P11](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0011), [v3 ch.Interlude P18](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0018)_

## Personality

Joseph is a daring and confident boy who maintains a generally peaceful disposition. However, he remains capable of fighting effectively when circumstances require it.

_Sources: [v2 XII A Jonah Day P18](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0018), [v3 ch.Relationships P63](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0063)_

## History

Joseph originally belonged to a cherished friend of [Aunt Euphemia](../character/aunt-euphemia.md) who relocated to [Vancouver](../codex/places.md#vancouver). He was brought by [Aunt Euphemia](../character/aunt-euphemia.md) to Tabby's Place, where, after initial skirmishes among the household pets, he became a close companion to Nell's cat, [Smudge](../character/smudge.md). During a visit to the home by [Cyril](../character/cyril-lisle.md) Lisle's family, Joseph and the other cats jumped on Mrs. Lisle during an awkward gathering.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Relationships P46](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0046), [v3 ch.Relationships P51](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0051), [v3 ch.Relationships P53](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0053), [v3 ch.Relationships P55](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0055), [v3 ch.Relationships P65](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0065), [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P3](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0003), +3 more_

### [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/joseph--nell-harcourt.md)

Joseph is a cat belonging to [Aunt Euphemia](../character/aunt-euphemia.md), placing him under [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) Harcourt's household authority as part of the family at Tabby's Place. [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) initially loathed Joseph during his early territorial cat fights with her own cat, [Smudge](../character/smudge.md). Despite this rocky start, Joseph remains a fixture of the household alongside the other animals.

_Sources: [v2 XII A Jonah Day P17](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0017), [v3 ch.Relationships P46](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0046), [v3 ch.Relationships P51](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0051), +3 more_

- Serves under  <sub>[v2 XII A Jonah Day P17](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0017)</sub>
- Enemy of — loathed him during his cat fights with Smudge (since v3)  <sub>[v3 ch.Relationships P63](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0063)</sub>

### [Smudge](../character/smudge.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/joseph--smudge.md)

Joseph and [Smudge](../character/smudge.md) are domestic cats living together at Tabby's Place. Though they engaged in initial skirmishes when [Aunt Euphemia](../character/aunt-euphemia.md) first brought Joseph to the house, the two cats quickly overcame their early hostility. They eventually became devoted companions who groom each other and share a pillow.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Relationships P46](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0046), [v3 ch.Relationships P51](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0051), [v3 ch.Relationships P53](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0053), +1 more_

- Friend of — devoted cat companions who share a pillow and groom each other (since v3)  <sub>[v3 ch.Relationships P65](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0065)</sub>
